title: Power Display -- Brightness Slider does nothing, Contrast slider controls brightness

judgment.rationale: The symptom is concrete and likely belongs in Power Display’s DDC/CI capability/control mapping. A maintainer-side repro can inspect the monitor capabilities and verify whether the issue is model-specific or a generic label/control mapping defect.
evidence: PowerToys v0.101.2632 from GitHub on Windows 11 Pro 25H2 build 26200.9457.
Two Acer Nitro XV272U V3 monitors are used with Maximum Compatibility Mode enabled.
Brightness does nothing and the Contrast slider changes brightness.
Acer display drivers are installed and a diagnostic ZIP is attached.
judgment.recommended_action: Design Power Display brightness/contrast mapping fix

fix_assessment.rationale: A repository change may be applicable to Power Display control mapping, but the monitor capability response must be checked before implementation-grade design.

proposed_fixes.title: Correct Power Display brightness and contrast control mapping
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The Maximum Compatibility Mode control mapping may associate the monitor’s brightness/contrast DDC controls with the wrong Power Display sliders for the Acer Nitro XV272U V3 response.
plan: Inspect Power Display DDC/CI capability discovery and the Maximum Compatibility Mode fallback mapping.
Compare the reported monitor capabilities with the VCP codes selected for brightness and contrast.
Correct the mapping or add a model-safe capability guard without changing normal monitor-specific mappings.
Add regression coverage for distinct brightness and contrast controls and a fallback case where a control is unsupported.
verification: On both Acer monitors, verify the Brightness slider changes brightness and the Contrast slider changes contrast.
Verify unsupported controls remain disabled or report failure instead of silently changing another control.

confidence.rationale: The swapped-control symptom strongly implicates capability/control mapping, but the attached monitor capability response is needed to choose the exact code or fallback branch.

issue_context.summary: Power Display on two Acer Nitro XV272U V3 monitors maps the brightness and contrast controls incorrectly in Maximum Compatibility Mode: brightness has no effect while contrast changes brightness. The report includes the exact monitor model, Windows build, admin/install details, and a diagnostic ZIP.

actions.label: Design Power Display brightness/contrast mapping fix
Reproduce Acer Power Display control mapping

prerequisites: Two Acer Nitro XV272U V3 monitors
Windows 11 Pro 25H2 or equivalent DDC/CI environment
steps: Open the Power Display controls for each Acer monitor.
Record the current OSD brightness and contrast values.
Move the Power Display Brightness slider and observe the OSD and actual brightness.
Move the Contrast slider and observe the OSD and actual contrast.
Capture the monitor capability/control mapping used by the compatibility path.
reproduce.expected_result: Brightness should change brightness and Contrast should change contrast; the reported behavior is no brightness response and contrast changing brightness.
